decisions.operating_mode: Wi-Fi-connected standalone remote programmer; no PC is required during target programming.
decisions.target_power: The probe must never power the target; the target is self-powered.
decisions.board_outline_revision: Rev A.1 uses a visually and geometrically reviewed 44 mm × 70 mm rectangular four-layer outline with no mounting holes or enclosure constraint. The ESP32-S3 antenna section protrudes beyond the top short edge; USB-C occupies the left portion of the bottom short edge with its documented PCB-edge datum aligned to the outline.
decisions.usb_power_policy: USB-default-power design with no PD or Type-C current-advertisement detection; worst-case 5 V input current must not exceed 500 mA.
decisions.target_interface_performance: Target cables up to 300 mm, SWD up to 4 MHz, and UART up to 3 Mbit/s.
decisions.expansion_policy: J4 is a trusted internal development header, is not hot-pluggable, and may draw at most 25 mA from probe 3V3.
decisions.manufacturing: JLCPCB four-layer PCB with SMT assembly; initial prototype quantity 5-10 boards.
decisions.firmware_validation: The user has validated SWD programming with an ATK-DNESP32S3M; firmware implementation is out of PCB scope.

invariants: VTREF is target-provided only and must not be tied to probe 3V3 or USB_5V.
J2 and J3 are alternative interfaces and only one target may be attached at a time.
The established J2/J3 signal contract carries STM32 SWD, NRST, BOOT0, and UART signals.
